# v0.8.0b6 — Everything for a car in its profile

Beta of the integration. **0.6.1 remains stable.** The beta app stays at
**0.8.0b4**; no app update is needed.

Changes compared with 0.8.0b5:

- **BavarianData is offered again for vehicle profiles:** on the supported Home
  Assistant versions, the integration did not find the registered BavarianData
  car. When
  adding a profile only **None** was offered, and editing an existing
  BavarianData profile skipped choosing the car and its vehicle entities. Both
  work again.
- **All settings of a car in its profile:** **Configure → Vehicles** lists the
  profiles. Opening one shows everything for that car in one place: name and
  vehicle source, charge level and charge limit, next departure, charging
  losses, detection signals and Virtual Plug & Charge. Each item explains what
  it is for. Any profile can be changed, not only the selected car; changing
  another car leaves the selected car's target and departure untouched.
- **Automatic selection in one place:** switch it on with **Automatic
  selection** in the **Active vehicle** entity. The duplicate switch in the
  options is gone.
- **Plug & Charge without a second permission:** every profile with detection
  signals takes part once the wallbox switch **Virtual Plug & Charge** is on. The
  separate per-profile permission is gone. With a planned departure, the car is
  paused first and charging starts in time.
- **Planned charging start:** a new sensor shows when the departure plan starts
  charging, or started.
- **Raised target re-plans:** raising the vehicle charge target after a trip was
  reached plans the same departure again.

If you set BavarianData up again in the meantime, the car is a new device. Edit
the vehicle profile, choose **BavarianData** and select the car again.

Update the integration through your installer's prerelease channel and keep the
existing entry.
